home.heroTitle: Pick a game you can all play
home.heroLead: Sign in with Steam, open a room for 2 to 8 people, and see the games you share. Then a wheel or a yes-or-no match chooses for the group.
home.stepEnterBody: Your public library joins on its own. If it's private, the room still works and tells you how to open it.
home.stepShareBody: Up to 8 people. The host can also paste a public profile to add that library.
home.stepDecideBody: The wheel lands on a cover. The match is yes or no, unanimous or by majority.
home.empty: This public library has no games.
home.private: Steam recognized you, but game details are not public. On your profile: Edit profile, Privacy settings, Game details, Public.
home.rateLimit: Steam is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
home.network: We couldn't reach Steam. Check the connection and try again.
home.unconfigured: The server is missing its environment variables. Fill them in and restart.
home.authFailed: Steam didn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.

room.notFound: That room doesn't exist or already expired.
room.privateHelp: To include a library: profile, Edit profile, Privacy settings, Game details, Public.
room.login: Sign in with Steam to join
room.already_in_room: That person is already in the room.
room.host_only: Only the person who created the room can paste a profile.
room.rateLimit: Steam is limiting store details. The rest can load later.
room.room_not_found: That room doesn't exist or already expired.

roulette.title: Wheel
roulette.empty: Nothing to spin with these filters.
roulette.allExcluded: You excluded everything. Put a game back in.
roulette.excludedNotice: You excluded {name}. It stays out of the next spin.

match.title: Match
match.login: Sign in with Steam to vote
match.libraryOnly: This profile is library-only. Sign in with Steam to vote.
match.empty: Nothing to vote on with these filters.
match.hint: Swipe right if you want to play it, or left if you don't. You can use the buttons too.
match.voteFailed: The vote didn't save. Try again.
